About this map

This public-facing explorer combines seven Louisville Metro / LOJIC datasets into one countywide reference map. It is designed for visual comparison and district-level exploration, not as a legal parcel determination.

2026 Annual Cut List: this layer contains the 832 current open-work-order records in the supplied public extract explicitly labeled “2026 Annual Cut List.” Louisville Metro describes the broader Annual Cut List as containing more than 1,400 abandoned properties, so these 832 records should not be interpreted as the complete universe of Annual Cut List properties.

Open Work Orders: points represent current PM open-work-order records. They should not automatically be interpreted as abandoned properties. Metro / Landbank Properties: the source layer contains several owner categories, including Metro Government and Landbank Authority.

Neighborhoods, zoning, municipalities and designated places are LOJIC geographic reference layers. Some geography types overlap by design.

Prepared from public GIS datasets, September 2026.
